modules.title: Sun, scattered light, star field
modules.description: The sun, a soft light from the shadow side and about 1,200 stars around the station. Link it into any scene for the same light and sky.

modules.title: Station structure: ring shell, spokes, axis, collector, hub hull
modules.description: The structure of the rotating station: the ring with its floor, ceiling and ribbed glass roof, six spokes with ladders and the bearing collar, the axis tube with the distribution mirror, the collector of honeycomb cells that faces the sun, the outer hull of the hub with windows, radiators and antennas, and the docking area with the hangar band.
modules.alt: The station from outside: a drum-shaped ring with a honeycomb collector on top

modules.title: Ships with engine glow
modules.description: Simple ships with wings and engine glow that arrive from the sun side.
modules.alt: Four small ships seen from afar

modules.title: Spoke elevator: tower, hall, cabin, doors, sign
modules.description: The lift that runs up a spoke from the ring to the hub: tower, hall, cabin with glass doors and its sign.
modules.alt: The lift tower with its hall at the bottom

modules.title: Ring city: streets, houses, trees, people, fields, homes, bar
modules.description: The city on the inside of the ring: streets, houses with lit windows, trees, people for scale, fields, terraced homes at the feet of the spokes and a bar.
modules.alt: Houses and streets standing on the inside of the ring, seen from the axis

modules.description: Opening: the first room after the entrance, with the title of the exhibition on a fabric banner.
modules.alt: Corridor of the first room with a banner over a door and a panel on the wall

modules.description: Where I come from: a timeline wall with earlier talks of this series, each with a still and its date. Its main exhibit, the timeline wall, shows stills of recordings published by others and is not included, so the room looks empty here.

modules.title: Museum room 5: lessons learned
modules.description: Lessons learned: a library with the book of AI incidents on a lectern, shelves, a reading table, a chair station with a video, a tablet, a room divider about the reverse centaur, a window onto a crowd of agents and a terminal. The text on the wall quotes Joseph Browning verbatim, from his post of 10 July 2024 (https://twitter.com/Joseph_Browning/status/1811022092176933325): "The underlying purpose of AI is to allow wealth to access skill while removing from skill the ability to access wealth."
modules.alt: Curved bookshelves along the wall, a round table with stools and a screen

modules.title: Museum centre room (the hall between the rooms): the better curve
modules.description: The centre room of the museum: the better curve, where a focused effort is followed by open reuse. The globe that stood in the middle of this room in the talk is not included. The "better curve" is the second half of the rebound graphic: a short, focused peak of effort followed by open reuse, instead of a permanent rise.
modules.alt: A chart on an easel: resources and entertainment over the years

modules.title: Museum building: walls, floors, gates, doors, sign, lights
modules.description: The round museum building in the ring: walls and floors of all rooms (one object across the rooms), the window band, the entrance gate, inner doors, the sign and the lights.
modules.alt: Floor plan of the round museum seen from above with the roof cut away

images.reason: WissKomm Wiki logo (Gerrit Hansen)

images.name: entrance_logo_side.png
images.reason: WissKomm Wiki logo (Gerrit Hansen)

modules.title: Hub lobby, space bar, job board
modules.description: The lobby at the hub where the lift arrives, with handrails for zero gravity, the space bar and a job board.
modules.alt: Outline of the lobby, a cluster of honeycomb cells, seen from above

modules.title: Map room: funnel, star map
modules.description: The map room of the hub: a funnel of galleries under a glass roof and a star map where channels are suns and videos and podcasts are planets. The glowing globe above the star map in the talk is not included; only a hidden helper sphere marks its place.
modules.alt: The map room cut open: galleries stacked inside a tall honeycomb dome

modules.title: Hub modules (one collection per module)
modules.description: The modules of the hub, one collection each: archive, coding room, event log, hall of memories, knowledge cluster, lab, meeting rooms, portal, reading room, recording studio, screening room, server hall, text chamber, transmitter, user interface, viewing room, workshop. Each module stands for one function of WissKomm Wiki.
modules.alt: Clusters of honeycomb cells, one cluster per hub module

modules.title: Tube railway with car
modules.description: The tube railway that connects the hub modules, with its car.
modules.alt: Six thin tubes running out from the centre

modules.title: Where Poly Haven models stood (empties with links, no files)
modules.description: Where furniture and plants from Poly Haven stood. Each place is an empty named after the asset, with its link; download the asset and parent it to the empty.
